valid.work-lock.json: Work-scoped lock with deterministic identity and stable operation-series ownership.
valid.operation-lock.json: Operation-series lock whose protected target matches the owning operation.

invalid.scope-target-mismatch.json: lock_scope and protected_target kind must agree.
invalid.uppercase-lock-digest.json: Lock digest characters are lowercase hexadecimal.
invalid.unexpected-expiry.json: Locks have no schema-level expiry field and cannot be cleared from age alone.

lock-id-digest-mismatch.json.description: The stable lock ID must equal the SHA-256 digest of the deterministic canonical lock key.

operation-owner-mismatch.json.description: An operation-series lock must be owned by the same operation identified by its protected target.
